content: If switching the Wdg module and the watchdog hardware into the requested mode is not possible, e.g. because of inconsistent mode settings or because some timing constraints have not been met, the Wdg_SetMode function shall return the value E_NOT_OK and raise the extended production error WDG_E_MODE_FAILED .
